# X Impact Simulator

> Experimental X-inspired audience and distribution simulator. Not a virality predictor. Not X production. No live X feed.

A creator submits a draft (text, up to 5 images, or a short video). Curated behavior profiles emit Phoenix-style affinities, which Python maps to assumed per-impression priors and scores with selected public RankingScorer defaults from xai-org/x-algorithm. A synthetic candidate-slate cascade then runs Monte Carlo rounds. The headline impact_score blends 35% persona prior with 65% median sampled population/ranking outcome; Groq never emits it.

## Product

- [App](/): Offline Impact Simulator UI
- [API health](http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health): FastAPI health (local)
- [Scoring notes](/llms-full.txt): Ranking formula, weights, datasets
